title: Ghost Form
description: After death, become a ghost and fly back to reclaim your body with a glowing beacon guide!
body:
# Ghost Form

Die and become a ghost! A bright particle beacon marks your death location.

## Features
- Ghost mode on death
- Particle beacon at death location
- Reclaim body and items
- No item loss

## Made with Orca
Created using [Orca](https://orcaclient.com/ai-minecraft-mod-maker) - AI for Minecraft modding
